name: floating-panel
title: Floating Panel
description: A compact Add Note button that expands into a floating card holding a title, a labelled textarea and, in the code, close and submit actions.
use: Users need to jot a short note from one button without leaving the page or opening a full form.
avoid: The panel anchors below the trigger and the fixed-height demo clips its footer actions.
a11y: The dialog does not trap focus or restore it, and the trigger's aria-expanded stays false even while the panel is open. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark rounded Add Note button sits alone on black. Clicked, it becomes a wider dark card below with a bold title, a Write your note label and a large empty text area; the original button stays as a blurred ghost.
behaves: The trigger button morphs into the panel with a spring while the backdrop blurs slightly; clicking outside or pressing Escape closes it and clears the note.
customise: Trigger label, title, textarea and footer actions are composed from exported parts; panel size and the spring are set in the demo and source.
weight: light: One panel and a blurred backdrop, animated only while opening or closing.
